_about: Accepted static analyzer findings. Compare is by file, checker and message shape, counted. Regenerate with `python3 scripts/analyzer-audit.py --write-baseline --log <transcript>` and read the diff: an entry that disappears means a finding was fixed, which is the only good reason for one to go.

_accepted_reasons.NSNumber nil test read as a boolean conv: the retain-count checker reports any NSNumber in a condition, including a nil test, and these sites compare or test for nil
_accepted_reasons.VideoToolbox parameter documented as pas: Apple's VTDecompressionSessionCreate says pass NULL for the default decoder; the header marks the parameter nonnull
_accepted_reasons.CGColorRef ownership through an assign p: the checker cannot follow a CoreFoundation reference kept in an assign property; the code retains before releasing and never calls either function with NULL
_accepted_reasons.user-facing text the localizability chec: wrapping the literal in MLString moved the translation behind a method call, and the checker stopped reporting the sites it can now see through; what is left is the count the CI transcript reports for the sites it still flags, kept exact rather than rounded, because a number that only ever goes down is a number nobody re-reads
